# We organise Corporate Groups Incentives, Meetings, Dealer Meets,  Corporate Outings and Corporate Travel

## Special Holidays – A MICE Friendly Company

Special Holidays has an exclusive MICE division to make it as of the leading MICE companies in India based in Delhi capable to serve the market demand for various MICE services. The MICE requirements of each company may vary based on their services/products, target audience and budget. With Special Holidays, you can enjoy the best services which can be altered as per your demands and needs. Our expert team assists corporate companies with their business travel and event management needs. They help you to make ever-lasting impressions on your customers and guests alike.


### Why Special Holidays

- Flexible, efficient and high-standard services
- Offer a full-spectrum of tourism services
- Themed events and incentive group events
- Reliable and capable
- Expert team
- Utilization of state-of-the-art tools and advanced technology to cater your needs

### Vision

- To be recognized as a leading MICE service provider throughout the world.

### Mission

- To provide high-quality and pleasant MICE experience to our clients
- Offer convenience, transparency and peerless services
- Optimum use of the budget

### Our Services

1. We have successfully organized the weddings and marriages in Delhi, Jaipur, Jodhpur, Udaipur, Kumarakom, Goa, Bali, Bangkok, Mauritius which covers from moderately budget to Luxury memorable events also.
2. We have organized various incentives and meets for the corporates and delegations both within India, Nepal, Sri Lanka and also to Malaysia, Thailand, Singapore, Hong Kong, Bali, London, Turkey, Egypt, South Africa, and Mauritius.
3. We have had the privilege of serving media groups from overseas.
4. Product launches in Delhi

You will get the most targeted services with the Special Holidays that can be customized as per your needs and demands. Our wonderful team of highly qualified and dedicated professionals handles each and every aspect of MICE tourism of your organization perfectly. The services that we offer include:


- Planning and budgeting
- Venue selection and contracting
- Staff planning and Allocation
- Airport transfer and Transport coordination
- Accommodation Management
- Itinerary Management
- Design Theme Conceptualization
- Entertainment Management
- Food and beverage
- Exhibition and Displays
- Tour arrangement
- Post-event winding up

![](https://www.specialholidays.com/img/contract-meeting.jpg)

#### Corporate Meetings

Whatever may be the business type, corporate events are an essential part of the business world. It is a platform to brainstorm about different new ideas and business ventures. There was a time when corporate meetings were confined within the walls of a conference room or a board room. But today, such meetings have taken up new turn. Business world look for premium meeting places to focus on company goals, visions and strategies. We arrange best venues for the corporate meetings and provide customized services as per your business requirements.

![](https://www.specialholidays.com/img/incentive1.jpg)

#### Incentive travel

There is no better way to boost your employee morale or inspire them than providing incentive travel or incentive event. In fact, it is the latest trend in the business world. Reward them or allow them to take a break from their mundane routine with a memorable travel experience. We have an efficient team to handle your incentive travel services. They understand your needs and customize your travel plan accordingly. Brief the team about your needs and leave the rest upon us. Let the name of your company or brand soar to amazing heights with unforgettable incentive travels.

![](https://www.specialholidays.com/img/Conference.jpg)

#### Conferences Management

Whatever maybe your business domain, conferences are an avoidable part of your business world and you must keep several key points in mind to make it a success. So, most of the companies prefer to hire a professional team to manage their conferences. Our expert team members know their job well and assist you at every step from choosing the venue to resource management and even in post-event wrap up. They ensure to check the quality of the event at all stages. Special Holidays has successfully handled many conferences over the years from various business domains.

![](https://www.specialholidays.com/img/exhi.jpg)

#### Exhibitions and Events

Hiring a MICE company is the best way to avoid several days of stress if you want to organize exhibitions and displays in a well-known location. Each exhibitor desires to mark it a presence of excellence and they can do that by hiring Special Holidays to organize their exhibitions or displays. From designing to setting up of the stall and display of products or services we can arrange everything for you to make the event successful. Special Holidays are completely at ease to arrange exhibitions and events after understanding the right objective and the key reasons of it.
